findings.title: update action does not apply any changes
findings.body: The update action just re-renders the embedding serializer and never reads params or saves anything. The client calls embedding.update({}) and the admin UI appears to save while nothing is persisted. Changes made in the embedding admin page are silently discarded.

findings.title: destroy and update crash on unknown id
findings.body: EmbeddableHost.where(id:).first can return nil; host.destroy and save_host(host) then raise NoMethodError and produce a 500 instead of a 404 for a missing or already-deleted host.

findings.title: category_id blank fallback and uncategorized handling
findings.body: save_host sets category_id from params and falls back to SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id when blank, but does not validate that the category exists. A non-existent category id is saved, and TopicEmbed.import then passes it to PostCreator, which can create topics in a missing category.

findings.title: before_validation mutates host with sub! and fails on nil
findings.body: self.host.sub! raises NoMethodError when host is nil (e.g. a create request without host param). It also mutates the string in place, which can affect frozen or shared strings. Use a nil guard and non-bang assignments.

findings.title: record_for_host lookup does not normalize stored host
findings.body: The lookup compares lower(host) with the URI host, but the stored host can include a port (validator allows :port) while uri.host excludes it, so hosts with ports never match. Also the port in the referer is silently ignored, which may allow unintended matches.

findings.title: host validation regex forbids valid hosts and host uniqueness is not enforced
findings.body: No uniqueness validation exists on host, so duplicate entries can be created; record_for_host then picks an arbitrary one (first without order), making the associated category nondeterministic.

findings.title: migration crashes when embed_category setting is missing and inserts unescaped values
findings.body: execute(...)[0]['id'] raises NoMethodError when no matching category exists (nil[0]). Also host values from the embeddable_hosts setting are interpolated into SQL without escaping, so a value containing a quote breaks the migration or allows SQL injection during migration.

findings.title: embeddable_hosts check uses cmd_tuples on a result and migration is irreversible
findings.body: The migration uses a conditional on cmd_tuples from a SELECT, and the change method has no reverse for the deleted site settings, so rollback loses the hosts and category configuration.

findings.title: imports ignore category when no embeddable host matches
findings.body: eh.try(:category_id) yields nil when no host matches, so PostCreator gets a nil category and topics fall back to defaults, replacing the old embed_category fallback silently. The uncategorized fallback behavior was lost.

findings.title: host check now trusts any referer matching a DB row without a referer guard
findings.body: The old code rejected empty embeddable_hosts with a specific message; the new check only calls host_allowed?(request.referer). Since referer may be nil, URI(nil) raises which is rescued only for InvalidURIError, so a nil referer may raise a TypeError rather than a clean InvalidAccess.

findings.title: category lookup uses categoryId which may be stale on save failure path
findings.body: host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(categoryId)) runs after save; findById may return undefined for a category not loaded, setting category to undefined and clearing the badge, while the record was saved with that id.

findings.title: delete ignores failure
findings.body: destroyRecord().then has no catch, so an AJAX failure leaves the UI in an inconsistent state with no error shown; other actions use popupAjaxError.

findings.title: saveChanges calls update with empty attrs against the non-persisting endpoint
findings.body: saveChanges calls embedding.update({}) which PUTs no data; combined with the controller that ignores input, the Save action does nothing for users.

findings.title: basePath replace only replaces first underscore
findings.body: type.replace('_', '-') only replaces the first underscore; multi-underscore type names will not match ADMIN_MODELS. Use a global regex.

findings.title: embedding edit label is lowercase and unused in templates
findings.body: The 'edit' key is added but the template uses an icon-only button, so the string is unused, and the 'Post to Category' label wording is inconsistent with other admin strings.

findings.title: expandable_first_post test asserts the wrong condition
findings.body: The 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' test no longer deletes or clears any host; it only passes because no host exists in the test, so it does not test what its name says.

findings.title: describe name refers to removed method
findings.body: The describe block name 'allows_embeddable_host' refers to removed API; also no test covers port handling, referer with path, or the nil/invalid URL cases of record_for_host.

findings.title: category fabricators were deleted from the category fabricator file
findings.body: The file now only defines :embeddable_host, removing :category, :diff_category, :happy_category and :private_category fabricators. Many existing specs (topic_spec etc.) use Fabricate(:category) and will fail; the content was moved to a file named embeddable_host_fabricator.rb, which is the reverse of the intent.
